name: smartphone_warranty_search
description:
Fetches complete warranty information for any smartphone sold in the US market.
Call once with brand and model. Returns structured warranty details including
limited warranty terms, extended plan features, and pricing — all from official sources.
Supported brands: apple, samsung, google, motorola, nothing
schema: [{"id":0,"property":"brand","type":"string","description":"Brand name in lowercase. Examples: apple, samsung, google, motorola, nothing","required":false},{"id":1,"property":"model","type":"string","description":"Full model name. Examples: iPhone 16, Galaxy S24 Ultra, Pixel 9 Pro","required":false}]
